questions.question: Choose the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order. 1 Western Europe 2 Germany 3 Munich 4 Europe 5 Bavaria [SSC SP P-12 2024 Eng]
questions.questionHtml:
Choose the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1 Western Europe

2 Germany

3 Munich

4 Europe

5 Bavaria
[SSC SP P-12 2024 Eng]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

4. Europe- continent

1. Western Europe- region within Europe.

2. Germany- A country within Western Europe

5. Bavaria- A state within Germany

3. Munich- A city within Bavaria
